name: template-usage
description: Track Harness template dependencies, usage, and adoption via MCP v2 tools. Find which pipelines or other templates reference a given template, analyze update impact, identify unused templates, and compare version adoption. Use when asked about template usage, template references, template dependencies, impact analysis before updating a template, finding unused templates, or tracking template adoption across projects. Trigger phrases: template usage, who uses template, template references, template dependencies, template impact, unused templates, template adoption. Do NOT use for creating or updating templates (use create-template instead).
